Message:
ath10k: enable set_tsf vdev command to WMI 10.4

10.4 firmware has addeded set_tsf vdev parameter,
hence enable it.
set_tsf function can be used to shift TBTT that will
help avoid its clockdrift which happens when beacons
are collided.
